checked_claims.note: The homogenization Y^3=XZ(X-Z) is a smooth plane cubic: the only infinite point [1:0:0] has dF/dZ=-1, and the affine singularities of y^3=x(x-1) would require y=0 and 2x-1=0 simultaneously with x(x-1)=0, which does not occur. Genus one follows. The x-map is degree three and totally ramified at the unique points over 0, 1, and infinity (valuations of x(x-1) equal to 1, 1, and -2, none divisible by 3). Riemann-Hurwitz gives 2g-2=3(-2)+3(3-1)=0. Deleting those three points yields a connected finite-etale degree-three cover C->B=M_{0,4}. Compact-support localization 0->Q->Q^3->H_c^1(C)->H^1(Cbar)->0 shows Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C;Q)=H^1(Cbar;Q), pure of types (1,0) and (0,1), while H_c^2(C;Q)=Q(-1). Q-coefficients throughout.

M_{0,18} is the complement of the pairwise diagonals in B^15 after rigidifying three markings to 0,1,infinity, so Mtilde is a nonempty Zariski-open in the irreducible 15-fold C^15 and is finite etale over M_{0,18}. H_c^0(C)=0, so compact-support Kunneth over Q puts every factor in degree 1 or 2; total degree 16 forces exactly one H_c^2 and fourteen H_c^1. Weight 2+14*1=16, so this is the whole of Gr^W_16 H_c^16(C^15;Q) up to the fifteen choices of which factor supplies H_c^2. Taking the (1,0) summand of each Gr^W_1 H_c^1=H^1(Cbar) yields a nonzero type-(15,1) class alpha (p=15<=dim=15, p+q=16). Y, the inverse image of the diagonals under a finite map, has dimension at most 14, so h^{p,q}(H_c^k(Y))=0 for p>14 even if Y is singular (Deligne via a hyperresolution of dimension <=14). Morphisms of MHS are strict; Gr^W_16 of localization is exact; alpha maps to a (15,1) class in a group with F^15=0, hence lifts to a nonzero type-(15,1) class in Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Mtilde;Q). No Gysin shift is used.

Riemann-Hurwitz for a degree-four genus-six cover of P^1 gives total ramification 18, so simply-branched covers have 18 distinct simple branch points. The ordered simply-branched Hurwitz space Hord^sb maps to M_{0,18} by the classical local-deformation theorem (etale) and by finiteness of transitive 18-tuples of transpositions in S_4 of product one up to conjugacy (finite); over C this is the algebraic Hurwitz covering. A transitive subgroup of S_4 generated by transpositions is S_4, whose centre is trivial, so these covers have no target-preserving automorphisms and Hord^sb is a scheme, smooth of dimension 15. CLM-0112-7 plus CLM-0112-4 give Hbar^bal smooth of pure dimension 15 with non-simply-branched locus of dimension at most 14 (discriminant non-reduced locus dimension <=17 on H, finite-stabilizer PGL_2-quotient drops dimension by 3), so some connected component X of Hord^sb has nonempty balanced open. Base change along Mtilde and passage to a connected component Xtilde meeting the balanced locus yields a connected finite-etale map f:Xtilde->Mtilde of positive degree d; Tr_f o f^*=d on compactly supported Q-cohomology, so f^* is injective and preserves Hodge type. V=Xtilde intersect Xbal is a nonempty Zariski-open in the irreducible smooth 15-fold Xtilde, hence connected, with complement of dimension at most 14; the same F^15 vanishing and FND-0165-style exactness of Gr^W_16 lift the (15,1) class to Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;Q).

V->Hbar^bal is a composite of etale maps (open in Xtilde; Xtilde->X finite etale; X->Hbar^{bal,sb} the branch-ordering cover, finite etale on the simply-branched locus; Hbar^{bal,sb} open in Hbar^bal). V is a separated finite-type smooth C-scheme, hence reduced and locally Noetherian, and carries the pulled-back balanced (CE)+(N) family, so it is a legitimate FND-0167 base. For any separated finite-type etale atlas U of Hbar^bal, U disjoint-union V is again such an atlas and V is a connected component of it. Additivity of H_c gives Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U disjoint-union V)=Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U) direct-sum Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V), so the (15,1) class survives on the atlas scheme. A finite direct sum of Q(-8) is pure of type (8,8); type (15,1) is incompatible, so the j=8 instance of (H-S) fails on V. Stack cohomology of Hbar^bal is never used (FND-0165 withholds it). Over Q, finite-etale trace identifies invariants with coinvariants; no graph automorphism or integral-coefficient issue arises.

The exact theorem_statement is a conjunction. After the Z-clause it states that the obligation includes the simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci, every S_6-isotypic component, and the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167. Those base/curve corners are not subobjects of Z; FND-0167 names them as (H-S) (Gr^W_{2j} H_c^{2j}(S;Q) a sum of Q(-j) for j=6,7,8) and (H-C). The sibling list items are asserted content, not a proof-route menu. S is universally quantified as a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas of the balanced tetragonal stack as in ATT-0112; Hbar^bal is that stack of dimension 15 by CLM-0112-7, and V is an allowed connected component of such an atlas. A universally quantified conjunct that fails on one allowed atlas is false. FND-0167 itself does not assert (H-S); the theorem does, by including those corners. The argument never identifies the class with the global kernel K, never produces a Gysin map or closed embedding in M_{6,6}, and does not claim that Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) itself fails to be Tate.

finding_candidates.statement: Let W be a smooth connected complex d-fold admitting a dominant, in particular finite etale, morphism to M_{0,d+3}, equivalently to the complement of the diagonals in (M_{0,4})^d. Then W admits a connected finite-etale cover W' with F^d Gr^W_{d+1} H_c^{d+1}(W';C) nonzero: pull back the degree-three Kummer cover C->M_{0,4} attached to y^3=x(x-1) in each of the d coordinates, take Q(-1) from one H_c^2(C) and H^{1,0}(Cbar) from the other d-1 factors, and observe that every locus removed along the way has dimension at most d-1, so the class survives by the FND-0165 corner together with F^d vanishing on the complement. Consequently no weight-equals-degree corner statement about such a base is etale-local, and no argument invariant under finite-etale refinement (transfer, averaging, monodromy-orbit counting, or descent along an atlas) can prove it.

finding_candidates.statement: A counterexample to (H-S) on an atlas S does not by itself refute the Z-clause of C66-TATE-SUPPORT. The FND-0167 maps inject the weight-16 corner of U into a sum of constant-coefficient corners of S, so they propagate Tate-ness downward and cannot propagate non-Tate-ness from S to U or to Z=Ord(U). The same dimension count blocks a direct FND-0165 lift of the (15,1) class from S to U: the complement of U in A has dimension 16, not at most 14. Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) remains open. The correct repair is to drop the universally quantified base/universal-curve conjunct, name any atlas on which (H-S) or (H-C) is asserted, and prove or conditionalize the Z-corner on that named atlas.

Packet identity checked first: TASK packet_id C66-001-v4, packet_sha256 13f880c2a12fa369d4fc2f75b476e70c0dbc070f25221987d06d1ff452af1c7d, packet_binding_sha256 76cc8a6d6ca02a2a9b1d7857fa11d7278f9732fa823f7be67dd51a354645bcc7, campaign_revision 4, context_revision 2, subproblem C66-TATE-SUPPORT, and the full target dictionary (g=n=6, dim 21, open BM degree 16 / weight -16 / type Q(8), compact H_c^16 type Q(-8), ordinary degree 26 / Q(-13), Poincare twist 21) match ATT-0118 field for field; the theorem_statement is identical to TASK.json. Strongest attack (scope and quantification). The counterexample never touches Z=Ord(U). It refutes only the included constant-coefficient base corner (H-S) at j=8. Three saving readings were tried. (1) 'This includes ... the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167' is a proof-route list, not a conjunct. Outcome: fails. The sibling items in the same list (simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci, every S_6-isotypic component) are asserted content, and the base and universal curve are not parts of Z, so the clause can only add conjuncts. FND-0167 names those conjuncts as (H-S) and (H-C). (2) The word 'a' in 'a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas' is existential, so a single wild chart V does not kill the theorem. Outcome: fails. No atlas is named; FND-0167 quantifies over any reduced separated finite-type C-scheme carrying the balanced setup; adjoining V to an arbitrary etale atlas U yields another allowed atlas U disjoint-union V whose H_c^16 contains the (15,1) summand by additivity. The same quantification is the one used by the campaign's atlas-corner lemmas for Hbar^bal. An existential reading would also make (H-S) at j=8 vacuous on affine 15-space (H_c^16=0), which cannot be the intended content. (3) ATT-0112's atlas is a smooth atlas of the fixed-target stack H^bal of dimension 18, so a 15-dimensional etale chart of Hbar^bal is out of scope. Outcome: fails. The theorem names the balanced tetragonal stack as in ATT-0112, and CLM-0112-7/FND-0162 identify that stack as Hbar^bal of dimension 15; FND-0167's S is any scheme carrying the balanced family, with no trivial-target requirement. V is such an S.

Secondary attacks also failed. Stack versus coarse: all Hodge groups are on schemes (C, C^15, Mtilde, Xtilde, V); FND-0165's stack exclusion is respected, which is why the statement is atlas-level and thus vulnerable. Rational versus integral: Q-coefficients, finite-etale trace is multiplication by degree. Cohomology versus Borel-Moore degree: the disproof is of Gr^W_16 H_c^16, the equivalent form written in the theorem; FND-0165 duality in the same degree with no extra Tate twist sends a non-Tate summand to a non-Tate summand, and Poincare twist 21 is unused. Tate twists: Q(-8) is type (8,8), incompatible with (15,1). Gysin/Kunneth: Kunneth degree/weight 2+14*1=16, Hodge type (1,1)+14*(1,0)=(15,1); no Gysin. Spectral-sequence differentials: none; Kunneth is an isomorphism and localization is a long exact sequence of MHS. Invariants versus coinvariants: finite-etale transfer over Q, no graph automorphisms. Semisimplification: a nonzero Hodge type already obstructs an isomorphism with a sum of Q(-8), with no extension gap. Predicted motives, algebraic/tautological generation, omitted stable pairs, and FND-0164's nonconstant-coefficient transfer are not used. Confirming this disproof does not verify C66-TATE-SUPPORT for Z and does not discharge RED-0001.
theorem_statement: Over C with Q-coefficients, on the balanced Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure model Z=Ord(U) of a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family on a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas of the balanced tetragonal stack as in the dual-confirmed ATT-0112, prove that the exact target graded piece of the H_alpha-object of Z is Tate of type Q(8) in Borel-Moore degree 16 (equivalently Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8)). This includes the simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci, every S_6-isotypic component, and the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167. Do not identify this with the global kernel K=ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)->H^{16}(D;Q)) (FND-0168). Do not construct a closed embedding, Gysin map, image, or support-exhaustion statement in M_{6,6}. This lemma does not resolve the campaign Hodge/Tate group RED-0001.
